name: Universal Logistics Services - Maryville Terminal - Maryville TN

fieldNotes.siteResolution: FMCSA SAFER (USDOT 839281, MC371555) lists Universal Logistics Services Inc at 1615 Robert C Jackson Dr, Maryville TN 37801 - confirmed via TruckMap, Waze, Buzzfile and D&B. The roster ROOFTOP geocode (35.754792,-84.012239) lands on a tan/white-roof metal warehouse at the corner of W Lamar Alexander Pkwy (US-321) and the Robert C Jackson Dr industrial park, immediately SE of a long cross-dock LTL freight terminal building. The two buildings share one paved truck yard. Center locked at the warehouse, 35.75479,-84.01224.
fieldNotes.operatorNote: Universal Logistics Services Inc, Maryville TN (est. 2005, GM Jim Brinkley, ~77-unit fleet) is a small independent freight carrier/brokerage. It is most likely NOT a subsidiary of Universal Logistics Holdings (ULH/NASDAQ:ULH) - the roster pulled it from an FMCSA name match. The site is audited as instructed, but the account linkage should be treated as uncertain.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The complex is in an open industrial park. The truck yard between the warehouse and the cross-dock terminal connects to Robert C Jackson Dr via open driveways; no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point was visible in satellite or Street View. Partial chain-link fence rings the yard but the entrances are open. truckGate = false (flagged uncertain - Street View coverage of the inner yard driveways is limited).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any entrance. guardShack = false; remoteGs = false (no controlled gate).
fieldNotes.docks: The cross-dock LTL terminal building (NW) has dock doors along both long faces with many trailers backed in - classic freight-terminal layout. The roster-coords warehouse (SE) has docks along its N face. Combined dock-door estimate ~40 across the complex; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: The shared paved yard holds numerous parked trailers (LTL freight terminal cycling) - dropArea 25-50, dropYard = true.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Internal approach from the Robert C Jackson Dr driveway to the dock faces is short (1-2 truck depth) - typical of a compact terminal. drivewayShort = true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct buildings on the complex - the cross-dock LTL terminal and the SE warehouse - sharing one yard. multipleFacilities = true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Maryville/Blount County is a small-metro edge setting; the site sits in a planned industrial park alongside DENSO and ICC, off US-321, with woods and farmland nearby. Classified Rural per the rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the complex. railServed = false.
